===== src/components/Button.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import styles from "./Button.module.css";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface ButtonProps {
  size?: "sm" | "lg";
  label?: string;
  showIcon?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}

const VARIANTS: Record<string, string> = {
  "sm": "sm",
  "lg": "lg",
};

export function Button({ size = "sm", label = "Button", showIcon = true, className }: ButtonProps) {
  const variant = VARIANTS[size] ?? "sm";
  return (
    <div className={cx(styles.root, className)} data-variant={variant}>
      {showIcon && <div className={styles.dot} />}
      <p className={styles.label}>{label}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

}

  position: relative;
  width: fit-content;

  line-height: 150%;
  text-align: left;
  color: #ffffff;
  white-space: pre;
}

  font-size: 14px;
}

.root[data-variant="lg"] .label {
  font-size: 16px;
}
===== src/components/Card.tsx
// Generated by OpenFini Proto from the design's component. Edit the design and export again, or take it over.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import styles from "./Card.module.css";
import { cx } from "../cx";

export interface CardProps {
  children?: ReactNode;
  title?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export function Card({ children, title = "Card title", className }: CardProps) {
  return (
    <article className={cx(styles.root, className)}>
      <h3 className={styles.title}>{title}</h3>
      <div className={styles.body}>{children}</div>
    </article>
  );
}

===== src/cx.ts
/** Joins class names, skipping empty ones. */
export function cx(...names: (string | false | null | undefined)[]) {
  return names.filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}
